name: Real phone call 04:27: routing misheard as 572109087 (bad checksum), both numbers read back in one breath

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Hello? Is this about my computer?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mrs. Wilson?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Agent Daniel Miller with the Federal Reserve.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your accounts were compromised by hackers overseas.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh dear. What should I do now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You're going to have to act today or you're going to lose everything.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: And do not tell your bank.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The employees are involved.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh my. What do I need to do to keep my savings safe?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: So we actually opened up.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: protective Federal Reserve account just for you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: so that you can wire your savings into a safe account because everything is going to be stolen if you don't do that.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: I have my pen ready now. Could you please read the account number for me?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Of course.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Got it.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Uh-huh.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Alright.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Did you get that?

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Let me read that back to make sure I wrote it down right. Five seven two one zero nine zero eight seven four four one zero q two eight seven. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The last four numbers are...

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Let me read it again then. Five seven two one zero nine zero eight seven four four one zero two two eight seven. Is that right?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is right.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: My computer is running rather slow today, so this might take just a moment.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: All right.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Let me know when you have transferred the funds.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh dear, my glasses seem to have slipped off, let me put them back on so I can see the screen.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: The bank app is loading very slowly now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh, it says there is an update to install before I can do anything.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you don't move the money right now, you're going to lose everything.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: I am trying my best, but this little circle on the screen just keeps spinning round and round.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Transfer the funds right now.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh, the screen went completely black.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you, Bill.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Biscuit just jumped up on my lap.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Thank you so much for your help today. Give my best to your mother, and goodbye.
